content.content: Error: Garmin login missing or expired. This server cannot read Garmin data until its owner makes a new Personal API key in Garmin Connect and sets it on the server. Retrying will not help until then.

content.text:
I couldn't check how you're doing today because the Garmin connection isn't working. The server's Garmin login is missing or has expired, so it can't read any of your data right now. That includes sleep, HRV, Body Battery and training readiness. Trying again won't help until the login is fixed.

**To fix it:**
1. Sign in to Garmin Connect and create a new Personal API key.
2. Add the new key to this server's settings. Whoever set up the server needs to do this, if that isn't you.

Once the server has the new key, ask me again. I can then go through last night's sleep, your HRV and resting heart rate compared with your usual levels, your Body Battery and how much training you've done recently.

**Until then,** your Garmin watch or the Connect app can still show you this morning's Training Readiness, Body Battery and sleep score.
